title: Reading practice: At-Takathur for stops and tadabbur: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Reading practice rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 9. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ (١) حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ (٢) كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ (٣) ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ (٤) كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ (٥) لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ (٦) ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ (٧) ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ (٨)

panels.title: Tadabbur
points: We will be asked about every blessing

keywords.def: stopping on a word, with a breath

questions.q: Read 102:5 to 7 and say how you stop on each ayah end.
questions.a: ٱلْيَقِينِ: al-yaqeen; ٱلْجَحِيمَ: al-jaheem; ٱلْيَقِينِ: al-yaqeen: 'arid madd on each.

questions.q: Reading rota: each pupil reads At-Takathur from the mushaf to the teacher. Everyone else writes a tadabbur paragraph in the portal response box. Start: 'At-Takathur warns me ...'
questions.a: Readings marked; a paragraph naming one distraction and one action.
Both warn against collecting and hoarding wealth (70:18: 'collected [wealth] and hoarded').
Knowledge of certainty, then seeing with certainty: knowing something, then seeing it for yourself.

questions.q: Why is «كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ» said twice (102:3 to 4)?
questions.a: A) For strong emphasis and warning. Repetition in Arabic gives emphasis: a firm warning.

questions.q: 102:8 says we will be asked about ...
Think again: At-Takathur says competing for more distracts us until we reach the graves (102:1 to 2). What do people compete for today?
questions.a: Followers, phones, money, cars, grades for show: anything that distracts from Allah.
